newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman starts cellular cos.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman starts cellular cos.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said it initiated coverage of several cellular communications firms.
-- Said started CommNet Cellular Inc as an outperform and set a 1997 price target of $34.
-- Said started 360 Communications Co with an outperform rating and set a year-end price target of $25 a share.
-- Said started Rogers Cantel Mobile Communications Inc as a outperform and set a year-end price target of $28 a share.
